## Triage: first grade (family closure card) — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-form` — the six record forms (`ObjectForm`, `DrawerForm`, `ModalForm`, `SplitForm`, `TabbedForm`, `WizardForm`: 13 `setError(` writes, 0 `setError(null)`), and, folded here from objectui#10683, `LineItemsPanel.tsx` (the load's success path never clears the load error) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the closure card for never-cleared `error` on the form side. objectui#10663 closed that family for the data views (PR objectui#10680), and its census left the forms out. A failed read keeps a form on its error screen after a later read succeeds: measured once through the real `SchemaRenderer` on `object-form` in edit mode, and once on `LineItemsPanel` (rows drawn under a stale banner). Since objectui#10572 the forms re-read on the invalidation bus, so a transient failure followed by any save elsewhere is an ordinary way in. A form that stays unusable after its data came back answers wrong ⇒ p2, as objectui#10578.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T18:30Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10683 and both threads, objectui#10663 and PR objectui#10680, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: the objectui#10578 shape, clearing on a successful commit, applied per source. Each form has two reads (the object schema and the record) and no run guard, so a record read that succeeds over a failed schema read must not clear the schema failure. One enumeration pin over the seven sites (fail, then succeed ⇒ the value or rows shown). **Region order: the `LineItemsPanel` row goes after PR objectui#10650 (objectui#10631, p1, open)**, which edits that file; the six forms need not wait for it.

PR 2 carries `LineItemsPanel` with `Fixes #10682`, after PR objectui#10650 lands.

The triage (`5837519011`): 「the objectui#10578 shape, clearing on a successful commit, applied per source. One enumeration pin over the seven sites (fail, then succeed ⇒ the value or rows shown).」

⇒ `Refs #10682` (PR 1, the six forms); `Fixes #10682` rides PR 2 (`LineItemsPanel`).
